name: Ask AI For IT

sources.title: Homepage — SaaS & AI tools directory with featured listings
Pricing — single plan: Featured Listing $9.99 one-time, 48h manual review, dofollow link
Submit entry — redirects to Google sign-in

requirements: No adult content or illegal services (stated on pricing page)
Google account required — 'Submit Tool' leads to a sign-in wall with 'Continue with Google' as the only visible option
Listing costs $9.99 one-time; no free plan is shown
preparation: Tool name, URL, description, category, pricing model (listings display 'Free trial from $X' style price labels)
workflow: Open https://askaiforit.com/submit/continue and sign in with Google
Select the Featured Listing plan at /select-plan/4 ($9.99) or reach it via the pricing page
Complete the tool details form (behind login — fields not publicly visible)
Manual review within 48 hours; listing goes live featured at the top of the homepage
watchFor: No free route — the only plan advertised is the $9.99 featured listing
Google OAuth is the only visible login method
Promises 'permanent dofollow link' — verify rel attributes after publish
Small directory; every homepage item is 'Featured', suggesting low organic volume
countsAsLive: The tool has a public /tools/<slug> page on askaiforit.com and appears under Recently added picks / category pages
unknowns: Whether a free submission exists for logged-in users (none advertised)
